name: tree-sitter-kusto
description: Kusto Query Language (KQL) grammar for tree-sitter

scripts.build:dll: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build', { recursive: true })" && clang -O2 -DNDEBUG -shared -I src src/parser.c src/scanner.c -o build/tree-sitter-kusto.dll -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,/opt:ref -Wl,/opt:icf && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('build/tree-sitter-kusto.dll', 'build/libtree-sitter-kusto.dll')"

author: Amaan Qureshi
